verdict.rationale: Mercury embeds narrow AI features inside the product: AI reads bills, auto-populates payment details and remembers recipients, and AI-powered automations help close the books. However, there is no evidence of a general built-in assistant you can hand tasks to. Its agentic surface (MCP server, CLI, agent skills) is built for external AI tools to connect to Mercury, not an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational assistant, open-ended task delegation inside the dashboard, independent corroboration of the embedded AI features.
